reason: The metadata points to an observability/system-table feature: exposing TiDB/TiKV CPU metrics through slow-query, statement-summary, and infoschema surfaces. The touched focus modules (`executor`, `session`, `sessionctx`) look like plumbing to collect/expose metrics rather than changes centered on planner semantics, executor correctness, expression typing, session protocol/txn behavior, privilege enforcement, statistics, or kv/store/parser logic. The target-module footprint is also limited (6 paths, ratio 0.196), so this is better classified as metrics/system-table work than a core target-module PR.
